_doc: Engines pollard-runtime --update keeps current. Each tracks its own source (branch or pull ref) and re-applies its patches; nothing here is hand-built. Add an engine here, not a folder on a machine.

llama.cpp.why: the K-quant ladder, every new architecture the day upstream adds it; composed decoding sampler

ik_llama.cpp.why: trellis IQ*_KT flagship and IQ4_K/IQ5_K types upstream does not have; K2-Horizon on the trellis lane

llama-stq.why: STQ1_0 ternary type (upstream PR #22836, open) plus our imatrix-aware STQ1_0 encoder

ifm-llama.why: K2-Horizon pre-tokenizer + chat template from the model's makers; MSVC regex fix for Windows
